I have implemented the `EventListener.BatchDurable` callback and the `DB` durability wait, notification, and stats APIs on the `feat/batch-durable` branch:

- **EventListener & Options**:
  - Added [`WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/options.go#L409-L412) and [`WriteOptions.GetCommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/options.go#L422-L428) in [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/options.go).
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/event.go#L921-L930) (`JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, `KeyCount`) and [`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/event.go#L969) in [event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/event.go), wired through [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/event.go#L1265-L1283) and [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/event.go#L1072-L1084).
- **Commit Pipeline & Metrics**:
  - Updated [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/commit.go#L298-L358) in [commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/commit.go), [`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/batch.go#L1715-L1728) in [batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/batch.go), and [`DB.applyInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/db.go#L790-L934) in [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/db.go) to measure wall-clock apply and WAL sync durations and invoke `BatchDurable` once per `Sync` commit (including on WAL sync failure, and never on non-sync commits or `DisableWAL`).
  - Added [`Metrics.DurableCommitCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/metrics.go#L351) and [`Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/metrics.go#L354) in [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/metrics.go), populated in [`DB.Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/db.go#L2182-L2184) only when `BatchDurable` is configured.
- **DB Durability APIs**:
  - Implemented [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L465-L473), [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L477-L483), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L487-L495), [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L499-L505), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L510-L518), [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L522-L528), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L532-L534), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L540-L548), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go#L552-L554) in [durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability.go), along with unit tests in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-e3m0e20t/durability_test.go).
